title: Deep Learning for Distinguishing Normal versus Abnormal Chest Radiographs and Generalization to Unseen Diseases
summary: deep-learning CXR classifier was evaluated on large training cohorts and six external datasets; discrimination varied by disease and COVID AUC was limited, while triage time reduction was simulated only. The result-bearing arXiv v1 was posted on 2020-10-22; the later same-result Scientific Reports article is linked in paper_url.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: deep-learning CXR classifier was evaluated on large training cohorts and six external datasets; discrimination varied by disease and COVID AUC was limited, while triage time reduction was simulated only.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed study does not establish validation or benefit beyond its reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning chest-radiograph classifier was trained on data from five Indian hospital clusters and tested on six external datasets to distinguish normal from abnormal images and assess unseen-disease performance.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
